gap: BHD IS UNCHANGED and three of round 8's four items ARE fixed, so this is a design loss, not a scope loss. SCOPE, by isolation in one session, data held constant, data-product forced bhd-erp via a document-start non-configurable window.__ERP_PRODUCT getter plus a MutationObserver re-stamp, accent verified #009bc1 on every capture, wave sheets cleared by data-vite-dev-id matching /style/wave/ plus any surviving rule carrying the pnp scope: ON vs OFF differs by 0 px on /payment (0/5,184,000), /purchase-order 0, /inventory 0, /invoice 0, /customer 0, /payment at 390x844 0/1,316,640, and dashboard 0/5,184,000; the CONTROL, two ON captures with nothing toggled, is also 0 on all seven, so the noise floor is zero this run and zero really means zero. The kill is itself gated: with pnp forced, the SAME kill changes 2,620,405/5,184,000 px on /payment (50.55%), 2,414,479 on /invoice (46.58%) and 343,325/1,316,640 on mobile /payment (26.08%), so the OFF frames are genuinely wave-free. Against the stored baselines the numbers are large (invoice 18.79%, customer 5.93%, dashboard 47.02%) and it is all seed-data drift, as r6/r7/r8 already cropped and proved; the BHD-forced /payment frame still paints the 220px labelled rail, UPPERCASE sort-caret headers and AntD's grey 'No Data Found' tray. THE FOUR ROUND-8 ITEMS, RE-MEASURED. (1) FIXED: /payment now renders .wave-empty - tile .wave-empty__art 56x56 radius 18px on rgba(43,87,216,0.08) with an accent rgb(43,87,216) glyph, headline 'No payments yet' 17px/600 rgb(16,24,40), body 'Payments you record against invoices are listed here.' 14px/400 rgb(91,103,121). Coverage went far past those two pages: over 22 empty lists I probed, 14 now get the full grammar (payment, credit-note with a real 'New credit note' action, suppliers, rfq, warnings, approvals, credit/queue, margin-approval, attendance, client-updates, reports, my-discipline, employees, and reorder-alerts with the best line in the product, 'All stocked up / Every item is above its reorder level. Nothing to order right now.'). (2) FIXED: the header band is ONE tone. On /payment I sampled the band row at 21 x-positions from x=400 to x=2680 and every one is rgb(241,244,249); the 2x crop shows an unbroken band running into the rounded top-right corner. Same single-tone result on /quote, /purchase-order, /delivery-note and /credit-note, all of which report .ant-table-ping-right true. (3) FIXED: /payment's toolbar is now three identical 40px/999px transparent pills with a rgb(43,87,216) border - the bar's exact grammar; /invoice is a white 40px/8px field, a white 40px/8px select, two outlined pills and one primary pill, all 40px, and r8's grey-filled select and naked circular gear are gone. (4) FIXED: the placeholder is Title Case 'Search' on /invoice, /quote, /customer, /taxes and /payment/mode. WHY IT STILL DOES NOT CLEARLY WIN. THE BIGGEST REMAINING THING IS /inventory - the one page the fix report named alongside /payment - which the render disproves. Its stock list paints NO tile at all: a bare rgb(16,24,40)-weight tray glyph roughly twice the optical mass of the flagship's, a Title Case headline 'No Stock Items' at 15px/600 where the system is 17px/600, a Title Case fragment 'Add First Item To Track Inventory' at 13px/400 rgb(51,65,92) where the system's sentence is 14px/400 rgb(91,103,121) and ends in a full stop, and a solid rgb(43,87,216) 40px/999px 'Add Item' at y=661 that is a pixel-for-pixel duplicate of the 'Add Item' at y=159 in the page header, 502 CSS px directly above it. The helper IS imported in pages/Inventory/index.jsx, but its only call is at line 658, on the movement-history DRAWER table; the block a user actually meets is hand-rolled JSX at lines 452-453 with inline fontSize 15/13 and var(--bhd-text) tokens, so the designed system never touches it. /opportunities is the second outlier: it gets the 56px/18px tile but the glyph stays rgb(91,103,121) instead of the accent and the headline is Title Case 'No Opportunities Match Filters'. Two more, both on the screens actually judged. The same ROLE still rasterises in two faces on one card - CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode reports .wave-brand and .ant-page-header-heading-title ('Payment List') as Plus Jakarta Sans while .wave-empty__title ('No payments yet') 300 px below it is Inter; Wave's frame is one family from the wordmark to the last cell. And at 390x844 the typed query breaks its own field: the .ant-input measures y=175 h=42 inside an affix wrapper at y=166 h=44 with overflow visible, so the input's box ends 7 CSS px BELOW the bordered wrapper and the descenders of 'zzqqxx' paint straight through the bottom border, at 16px against the 14px of every neighbouring control. It is inherited from BHD, which overflows by 13px, so it is an un-made decision rather than a new defect - exactly like the lowercase placeholder r8 named - but it is the largest text on the judged mobile screen and it sits on a broken line. WHICH PAGES GET WHAT, PLAINLY: full designed state on payment, invoice, customer, credit-note, suppliers, rfq, warnings, approvals, credit/queue, margin-approval, attendance, client-updates, reports, reorder-alerts, my-discipline, employees; styled tile-and-headline fallback with no sentence and no action on purchase-order, delivery-note, tenders, vendor-vat, cost-engine-issues, attendance-corrections; outside the system on inventory and opportunities.
